instrument.description: Scope name from the SerialEM `[T = SerialEM: <scope> <date>]` header of the session's raw .mdoc/.idoc files (several scopes: joined by '; '). Older lines may hold a kind (glacios_serialem / smartscope / unknown).

magnification.description: Distinct nominal magnifications (x) of the imaging images (ExposureDose > 0; atlas files and dose-0 low-mag / search maps left out)

pixel_size_a.description: Distinct PixelSpacing values (Å/px as recorded, binning included) of the imaging images (ExposureDose > 0; atlas files and dose-0 low-mag / search maps left out)

defocus_um.description: Measured Defocus (µm, SerialEM sign: negative = underfocus) of the imaging images (ExposureDose > 0; atlas files and dose-0 low-mag / search maps left out): min / median / max

target_defocus_um.description: Distinct TargetDefocus values (µm) of the imaging images (ExposureDose > 0; atlas files and dose-0 low-mag / search maps left out)

dose.description: ExposureDose per image (e/Å²) of the imaging images (ExposureDose > 0; atlas files and dose-0 low-mag / search maps left out): min / median / max

binning.description: Distinct camera Binning values of the imaging images (ExposureDose > 0; atlas files and dose-0 low-mag / search maps left out)

acq_dates.description: First and last image DateTime over all the session's raw .mdoc/.idoc files (scope clock)

n_mdoc.description: .mdoc + .idoc files in `<session>/2. Raw images/` (atlas files included)

acquisition_gap.description: Why the acquisition fields are missing or partial (no raw folder, parser not found, unreadable files)

sample_labels.description: scope slot -> sample label, from the session's sample_key.csv

session_grids.description: scope slot -> inventory Grid# (null if unknown)

local_folder.description: Session folder, as `<processing root name>/<session id>`

logged.description: Time this line was written. Last line per id is current.

status_by.description: people.json id of whoever set this status explicitly (registry.py set-status); explicit beats derived
